command: python3 -B -c 'import pathlib,json,os,subprocess; P=pathlib.Path; pid=subprocess.check_output(["systemctl","show","dfx-mgr.service","-p","MainPID","--value"],text=True).strip(); paths=["/sys/kernel/config/device-tree/overlays","/sys/class/drm","/dev/dri","/sys/bus/platform/drivers/zocl"]; print(json.dumps({"pid":pid,"directories":{p:[x.name for x in P(p).iterdir()] if P(p).is_dir() else None for p in paths},"fdinfo":{str(p):p.read_text() for p in P("/proc/"+pid+"/fdinfo").iterdir() if "inotify" in p.read_text()},"drm_clients":{str(p):p.read_text() for p in P("/sys/kernel/debug/dri").glob("*/clients")}},indent=2))'
